item.title: Great Changes and Opportunities in the Next Decade
item.description: 1. Drawing the Heavy Sword, Challenging the World Since 1840, China endured more than a century of humiliation; yet starting in 1978, it took only a little over forty years to turn from a poor and weak great power into a wealthy and strong one. This is a manifestation of a nation’s resilience and wisdom.
